mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly growth in GDPC1 (demand) over the past year signals strong economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in expanding economies are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 4.2% triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to heightened labor market uncertainty.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross the 4.2% threshold or 20-day forward returns remain non-negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous quarterly growth in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) above their 12-month averages signals economic overproduction, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO above 12-month averages
failure_condition: The interaction between GDPC1 and INDPRO is not statistically significant or 60-day forward returns are not negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), a sustained increase in FEDFUNDS triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher interest rates.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not indicate a tightening regime or 20-day forward returns remain positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO (supply) above 105 indicates excess production capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not sustain growth above 105 or 20-day forward returns are not negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden jump in INDPRO above 105 triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to market concerns about overproduction.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not exceed 105 or 5-day forward returns remain non-negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS (monetary tightening) and UNRATE (labor market stress) signals contractionary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The combination of FEDFUNDS and UNRATE movements is not present or 20-day forward returns are not negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained quarterly growth in GDPC1 (demand) does not predict positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as market expectations are already reflected in prices.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth occurs in a non-late-cycle regime or 60-day forward returns are positive (t-test p > 0.05).
